mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam may increase renal potassium retention through effects on renal hemodynamics, while spironolactone increases serum potassium via aldosterone antagonism, creating additive hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and renal function regularly; consider dose adjustment of spironolactone if used concurrently, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
